technicalDecisions.decision: Use Databricks Zerobus Ingest instead of Azure Event Hubs
technicalDecisions.rationale: Eliminates message bus complexity. Direct Delta Lake writes with sub-5s latency. Lower cost than Kafka. Perfect for single-sink use case (Databricks as primary destination).

technicalDecisions.decision: Use Langfuse for agent trace visualization
technicalDecisions.rationale: Open-source, GenAI-focused, beautiful UI. Alternative to LangSmith (vendor lock-in). OTLP support for flexibility.

technicalDecisions.decision: Separate Delta tables for platform events and agent traces
technicalDecisions.rationale: Different schemas, query patterns, and retention policies. Easier to evolve independently. Clear separation of concerns.
One user can have multiple sessions. Session = atomic unit of interaction. Better granularity for analysis.
Don't block API responses on event delivery. Eventual consistency acceptable for analytics. Zerobus SDK handles retries.
Type safety, automatic documentation, validation at write time. Prevents bad data in Delta Lake.

technicalDecisions.decision: JSON record type for Zerobus (not Protobuf)
technicalDecisions.rationale: Simpler for Phase 2 development. Flexible schema evolution. Can switch to Protobuf in Phase 6 for production optimization.

risks.risk: Zerobus connection failures cause event loss
risks.mitigation: Zerobus SDK implements automatic retry with exponential backoff. Log failures to local file as fallback. Monitor Zerobus health via Databricks UI.

risks.risk: High event volume exceeds Zerobus throughput (100 MB/s per connection)
risks.mitigation: Start with reasonable volume. Zerobus scales to 10+ GB/s per table. Monitor throughput metrics in Databricks.
End-to-end integration tests validate propagation. Logging at each hop. Documentation with examples.
Use sampling for high-volume production. Benchmark with/without OTel. Optimize span creation.
Monitor usage daily. Implement sampling in production. Budget for paid tier if needed.

risks.risk: Delta Lake schema evolution breaks queries
risks.mitigation: Use schema evolution mode 'merge' (default). Test schema changes in dev environment. Document schema versioning strategy.
